title: Door and release handle usability
summary: Feedback centers on door and release-handle usability, with negative comments about awkward opening behavior and poorly placed release controls alongside several ambiguous reports about unlocking methods and handle locations.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe doors that only half open or open slowly, release controls that feel awkward or unsafe in use, and handle or hood release placements that are hard to find or operate.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention door unlocking with phone or handle interaction and hard-to-reach or unclear release-handle locations, but the examples do not consistently show whether the comments are complaints, instructions, or design suggestions.

limitations: The topic mixes door handles, door unlocking behavior, interior door releases, and hood release placement rather than one clearly uniform issue.
Several fragments are too brief or instructional to determine sentiment confidently.
The examples are limited to US G70 reviews and are not representative estimates of broader ownership experience.
